_note: Layer 2 of the zone-to-policy table. Every field cites entries in Docs/D5_POLICY_REGISTER.md. Only PRIMARY-VERIFIED entries are used for regulatory basis. 'Candidate policy response' = an existing instrument that the zone profile makes relevant, not a recommendation. Drafted 2026-10-08.

I1.name: Residential rooftop solar, net billing (2569 round)
I1.terms: <= 5 kW per meter, 2.20 THB/kWh, 10 years, combined MEA+PEA target <= 500 MW, First come First served, SCOD within 2570; rooftop only, ground-mounted excluded
I1.institutions: ERC (regulation and invitation); PEA or MEA (purchase, connection approval)
I1.regulatory_basis: Energy Industry Act B.E. 2550 s.11(1),(4); ERC rooftop regulation B.E. 2562 cl.10; NEPC 1/2569 (175), 29 Apr 2569
I1.connection_gate: PEA: aggregate export on one distribution transformer <= 25% of transformer kVA; PEA may limit inverter size or require an export-limiting device
I1.spatial_targeting: none: allocation is First come First served nationwide (P2a cl.10)
I1.citation_note: P2 (MEA announcement) applies only in the MEA service area and is cited only for MEA provinces

I2.name: Community solar farm (Community-based Solar Power Generation Project 2569)
I2.terms: ground-mounted VSPP <= 10 MW per project, total <= 1,500 MW, FiT 2.1679 THB/kWh, Non-Firm 25 years
I2.institutions: ERC (regulation); MEA and PEA (buyers; set each project's capacity); Ministry of Interior (defines eligible community areas)
I2.regulatory_basis: ERC Regulation on Community-based Solar Power Generation Project B.E. 2569, Royal Gazette vol.143 special section 230 Ng, 22 Sep 2569; Energy Industry Act s.11(1),(4); NEPC 3/2568, 4/2568, 2/2569; CEPA 9/2569
I2.connection_gate: utility sizes each project to grid capacity at the MEA/PEA feeder connection point and to the area load profile, with no reverse flow to the EGAT transmission system (cl.7)
I2.spatial_targeting: tambon-level community eligibility (Ministry of Interior); the one-plant-per-tambon rule was removed by CEPA 9/2569 (P11, context only)
context_only: P11: EPPO public summary, self-disclaimed as not an official reference; the binding outcome is cited through P1, whose preamble lists CEPA 9/2569

I3.name: Progressive residential tariff (first 200 units)
I3.terms: progressive rate for residential customers, applied from the September 2569 bill; average retail rate expected to fall from 3.95 to about 3.86 THB/kWh
I3.institutions: NEPC (policy); ERC (approval); MEA and PEA (proposal and billing)
I3.regulatory_basis: Energy Industry Act ss.64, 65, 67; NEPC 1/2569 (175) and 2/2569 (176)
I3.spatial_targeting: none: nationwide tariff measure, already in force; context for affordability, not a zone-specific instrument
I3.role: equity context / consumer-protection instrument (not a distributed-solar deployment instrument)

I4.name: Energy Conservation Promotion Fund (ENCON Fund)
I4.terms: revolving fund, grants or subsidies to government agencies, state enterprises and private parties for energy conservation (s.25)
I4.institutions: Fund established in the Ministry of Energy; Fund Committee chaired by a Deputy Prime Minister, EPPO Director as secretary
I4.regulatory_basis: Energy Conservation Promotion Act B.E. 2535 as amended B.E. 2550, ss.24, 25, 27
I4.spatial_targeting: none in the Act; allocation criteria are set by the Fund Committee (s.28)
I4.eligibility_caveat: s.25 covers energy conservation. The Act text read here does not state that distributed solar generation is eligible, so solar capital support is listed only as 'eligibility to be confirmed'
I4.role: conditional candidate: eligibility for solar investment not confirmed from the Act text (s.25 covers energy conservation)

G1.name: Utility connection verification (distribution grid code)
G1.terms: network licensee must allow connection under requirements it announces
G1.institutions: PEA (in its service area); MEA (in its service area)
G1.regulatory_basis: Energy Industry Act s.81; PEA Act B.E. 2503 s.31; PEA grid-use regulation B.E. 2559; PEA connection announcement for the 2569 residential programme
G1.spatial_targeting: applies everywhere; determines feasibility case by case

zone_rules.all_zones: I1 and G1 apply in every PEA zone. I1 has no spatial or equity targeting (First come First served).
zone_rules.nearer_or_intermediate_MV: I2 is a candidate where PEA members are in the nearer or intermediate MV class, subject to cl.7 sizing.
zone_rules.farther_MV_members: I2 only after a connection-cost and reinforcement assessment for the farther-MV provinces.
zone_rules.highest_poverty_zone: Affordability: I3 already applies nationwide. Targeted capital support through I4 is a candidate only, eligibility to be confirmed.
zone_rules.lowest_poverty_farthest_MV_zone: I4 energy-efficiency (conservation) support, which is within s.25 purposes.
zone_rules.MEA_provinces: MEA instruments (P2) and MEA feeder data; outside the PEA scenarios.
